resources.string: Test 3: CPU-command upload elision and render-path diagnostics. Requires the eligible G99 device and test profile; restart the game.
Test 3 requested. Keeps the GLES/cache/state baseline, adds optional direct submission of CPU draw lists and G99 Render / G99 Wait log windows.

Unofficial Test 3 replaces CPU lists uploaded for individually issued indirect draws with direct submission only without true multi-draw indirect and with the required direct support. GPU-provided commands are untouched; no draw merging or shader quality changes. FPS may be unchanged if the path is unused or GPU/Java-bound. Log timings are CPU wall time, NOT GPU duration. Restart after changing settings.
Not implemented in this experimental build: no validated AI interpolation pipeline or model is integrated. FSR1 is spatial upscaling, not AI frame generation.
Optional: replaces known graphics settings after confirmation. Not needed when Test 2 settings are already enabled.

Replace current rendering settings with G99 defaults? Native GLES preference, no error suppression, automatic GL version, 64 MiB GLSL cache, compute/timer/DSA extensions off, FSR1 off, capability-filtered default multi-draw order and Helio G99 Test on. This resets custom multi-draw rankings too. Unknown JSON keys remain. Back up MG/config.json if you want your old manual settings. Restart the game afterward.

New in Test 3. Avoid temporary indirect command construction/upload when no real driver batching exists. Keep the G99 profile ON and compare this switch alone OFF/ON, restarting the game. Check bypass_batches in the log. No FPS guarantee.
